steps.name: Thiago
steps.text: Pick up the pace!

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Ugh...

steps.name: Thiago
steps.text: This... nethersea brand. What exactly is it?

steps.name: Torturer Cultist
steps.text: Though tiny and varying in form, these fluorescent lifeforms are also an extension of our kin.

steps.name: Torturer Cultist
steps.text: The Prophet once said there's a part of the ocean where these glowing creatures fill the entire sea. They are the Whole, and they shape the cradle of life for our kin.

steps.name: Torturer Cultist
steps.text: The 'nethersea brand' is just fragments of His will from tens of thousands of nautical miles away, washed in like the tide. Even a tiny amount will inevitably consume the land.

steps.name: Torturer Cultist
steps.text: It will turn the land into a new kind of ocean.

steps.name: Thiago
steps.text: ...Indeed.

steps.name: Thiago
steps.text: So Iberia was the first sacrifice for your plans, and Gran Faro is the next.

steps.name: Torturer Cultist
steps.text: Sacrifice? Surely you're using the wrong word?

steps.name: Thiago
steps.text: No.

steps.name: Thiago
steps.text: The Inquisition will take away my town. And this 'beautiful' nethersea brand will do the same.

steps.name: Thiago
steps.text: Either way it's no longer our home. It'll lose its history, its golden years of explosive growth and vitality.

steps.name: Torturer Cultist
steps.text: Thiago, surely you don't mean—

steps.name: Thiago
steps.text: Jordi has been taken away as well. The ones who escaped have probably all been rounded up by the Penal Battalion by now.

steps.name: Thiago
steps.text: You're all murderers.

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: — (Screeches excitedly)

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Mon3tr?!

steps.name: Torturer Cultist
steps.text: Why would it show up here?! Impossible! It was just on the west side of town—!

steps.name: Torturer Cultist
steps.text: You lied to us, Thiago!

steps.name: Torturer Cultist
steps.text: And you too?!

steps.name: Calm Townsperson
steps.text: Before becoming an Inquisition spy, I was just the daughter of an ordinary Gran Faro laborer.

steps.name: Calm Townsperson
steps.text: Don't underestimate our hatred. All the humiliation we've endured was just to take you all down.

steps.name: Thiago
steps.text: Both you lot and the Inquisition are nothing more than enemies trampling over our home.

steps.name: Thiago
steps.text: See for yourself what real destruction looks like. See for yourself what we saw back then.

steps.name: Elysium
steps.text: Thiago! Get down!

steps.name: Thiago
steps.text: Ugh!

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: (Screeches)

steps.name: Jordi
steps.text: There's nothing left to tinker with. Everything else is out of power...

steps.name: Jordi
steps.text: All that remains is to see how long this lighthouse can hold out.

steps.name: Jordi
steps.text: (The nethersea brand has already reached this floor?)

steps.name: Jordi
steps.text: I'll have to keep climbing higher.

steps.name: Jordi
steps.text: High Inquisitor...
His arms have gone numb.
The shape of the reef has already changed dramatically. The High Inquisitor spares no effort when annihilating all enemies in his sight.
But his enemies are quite literally endless.
His sword is corroded, and he's expended his roll of explosives.
Only the flame in his lantern burns even brighter than before.
Not once does Dario look behind him, to the lighthouse he has defended from the beginning.
He looks beyond the sea's horizon.

steps.name: High Inquisitor Dario
steps.text: Creatures of the sea, Iberia will not be destroyed by you.

steps.name: High Inquisitor Dario
steps.text: Humanity will not be destroyed by you.
He hacks up the blood stuck in his throat. A metallic scent fills his nostrils.

steps.name: Sea Terror
steps.text: (Slow slithering sounds)

steps.name: High Inquisitor Dario
steps.text: And I, too, will not be destroyed by you. That would take more than death.

steps.name: Captain Alfonso
steps.text: Be patient and wait here, Garcia.

steps.name: Chief Mate
steps.text: (Squats beside the captain obediently)

steps.name: Captain Alfonso
steps.text: It's always boring, waiting for our quarry to take the bait.

steps.name: Captain Alfonso
steps.text: Still remember the second time we went to hunt these monsters? We still had over a hundred survivors back then.

steps.name: Captain Alfonso
steps.text: When we first set sail, the air was filled with cheering and salutes from the cannons. Those sounds still echo in our ears to this day. We bid farewell to the grand shore, carrying the legends of Ægir as we sprinted towards the depths.

steps.name: Captain Alfonso
steps.text: After a few days at sea—yes, only a few days—calamity struck.

steps.name: Captain Alfonso
steps.text: Graaah... Why did these stupid goddamn cells rob you of your language?

steps.name: Captain Alfonso
steps.text: How I wish to chat with you again, rather than those stupid, rancid idiots who took over sixty years to get here!

steps.name: Chief Mate
steps.text: (Rubs Alfonso's hand in sorrow)

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Good day, Mister Captain.

steps.name: Captain Alfonso
steps.text: Oh, we just happened to be short some bait. Fancy a dip? Considering you're an Ægir, after all.

steps.name: Captain Alfonso
steps.text: What? Already forgotten what I said?

steps.name: Captain Alfonso
steps.text: Either you leave, or I toss you overboard.

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: It's a miracle you survived. I never thought any Iberians would've made it after all this time.

steps.name: Captain Alfonso
steps.text: That's got nothing to do with you, or with Iberia. After sixty years, the only thing I belong to is this ship.

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: But, we—

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Let me give it a try, Skadi.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: How goes the hunt?

steps.name: Captain Alfonso
steps.text: Maybe my extremely cordial attitude has stoked a number of misunderstandings. But I can tell that the blood of monsters flows in your veins, just like me.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: We're... the same?

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: You, us, and your chief mate too?

steps.name: Captain Alfonso
steps.text: ...Who gave you permission to talk about Garcia? Who gave you permission to LOOK at my Garcia, you filthy Ægir mongrels?

steps.name: Captain Alfonso
steps.text: I never told you what Garcia used to be. You don't know if they were a man or a woman, tall or short, fat or skinny, Perro or devil.

steps.name: Captain Alfonso
steps.text: But know that Garcia is my chief mate and my lover, and I will never reveal their former self to outsiders.

steps.name: Captain Alfonso
steps.text: We don't need your pity, or a comparison to whatever image of us you might have from the past. Neither of us need any of that.

steps.name: Captain Alfonso
steps.text: What a joke. Hunters whose blood is mixed with that of their prey. Not even the ocean's waves can wash away your filth, yet you dare bare your fangs in front of us?
Skadi's brows furrow into a frown. She rarely cares about what others have to say, especially land-dwellers. But the words coming from the exception in front of her make her feel uncomfortable.
The chief mate shoots a sharp glance at Skadi. It is a warning.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: But, we need your help.

steps.name: Captain Alfonso
steps.text: ...What do you call these monsters again? Sea-something?

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Oh, 'Seaborn.'

steps.name: Captain Alfonso
steps.text: Okay, so why should we help you Seaborn? Do you know how many good lads lost their lives to the sea after the calamity?

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: You float around on these waters and refuse to return to port, yet still insist that you're an enemy of the sea?

steps.name: Captain Alfonso
steps.text: Yup. That's my life.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: We are... Abyssal Hunters. We come from Ægir, and while we can only guess how exactly you survived, we have nothing but respect for you.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: We also hope you'll understand that everything we do is to fight against those enemies.

steps.name: Captain Alfonso
steps.text: And I should care about what Ægir does, why?

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Er, no, you misunderstand.
Skadi shoots a glance at Specter beside her. When she'd said 'let me give it a try,' Skadi thought she meant that she'd be better at negotiating.
But drawing her weapon should absolutely not be a part of 'negotiations.'

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Let me rephrase that. It's our job to slaughter them. And I happen to find that process rather enjoyable.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Since you're only hunting for food, I can leave you some of the meat when I'm done. After all, I've never liked dealing with that nauseating stuff.

steps.name: Captain Alfonso
steps.text: You... think pretty highly of yourselves, eh? Compared to the Victorians, or Leithanians? I've seen the way you kill Seaborn. You aren't worth a damn thing.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Oh, don't get us wrong, dealing with these low-level creatures we call Sea Terrors doesn't even count as combat for the 2nd Company. Gladiia isn't exactly the stingy type either.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: I'm stronger than you. That's just an indisputable fact.

steps.name: Chief Mate
steps.text: Hraagh...!

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: My, let's not get ahead of ourselves, Mister Chief Mate. Or, Miss? Anyway, it's not your turn yet.

steps.name: Captain Alfonso
steps.text: ...Lay a finger on Garcia, and you're dead.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Oh really?

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Since our captain's mission is to retrieve this ship and return to Ægir, we don't have the luxury of sitting around trying to convince you.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: This way's always been the more straightforward means of communication—the Hunters' way.

steps.name: Captain Alfonso
steps.text: Hah, you've got a death wish!

steps.name: Seaborn
steps.text: Kin, I've come for you.

steps.name: Seaborn
steps.text: To hunt and consume, is an important matter.

steps.name: Seaborn
steps.text: You, are not all kin. But I know, you can still return to our kind.

steps.name: Seaborn
steps.text: So I ask, what will you do?

steps.name: Captain Alfonso & Specter
steps.text: Piss off!

steps.name: Captain Alfonso
steps.text: Hah, now there's an easy way to prove that you're not a Seaborn. Kill it. Unless you're unwilling to attack your 'kin.'

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Then I sincerely hope that you won't drag me down.

steps.name: Captain Alfonso
steps.text: I'm more worried about you showing mercy to your twisted 'kin,' Ægir.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Then you worry over nothing. After all, if I really was on their side, you'd be dead already.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: So, once I prove I'm not one of them, are you willing to lend us your ship?

steps.name: Captain Alfonso
steps.text: Not a chance in hell. The ship belongs to me.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: That's too bad. Maybe if I help you lose that arm of yours during this battle, that'll wake up a part of your humanity?

steps.name: Captain Alfonso
steps.text: Chief Mate! Stay back, don't do anything. Let's see how much of a difference there is between us and these monsters claiming to be human.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: You too Skadi, don't snatch my mark. This hunt is mine. And I need to... let off a little bit of steam.

steps.name: Seaborn
steps.text: Hunting, must be done.

steps.name: Seaborn
steps.text: Purpose, to mold the environment.

steps.name: Seaborn
steps.text: You, are rich in nutrients.
